map.内撕裂和边撕裂分别说明什么？: What Do Internal Tear and Edge Tear Each Show?
map.内撕裂(内部撕裂度)主要表征纤维结合强度，边撕裂(边撕裂)表征边缘抗起始裂口能力: Internal tear mainly characterizes fiber bonding strength, while edge tear characterizes the edge's resistance to initiating a tear. Packaging resistance to handling damage depends more on edge tear, while printed surface strength relates to internal bonding.
map.撕裂强度单位与测试方向？: Tear Strength Unit and Test Direction?
map.常用 mN（毫牛顿）。撕裂对纹向敏感，标准规定纵向/横向取样；对比时务必同方向，: mN (millinewton) is the common unit. Tear is sensitive to the grain direction, and the standard specifies both longitudinal and transverse sampling — always compare in the same direction or the values are not comparable.
